qa.method: Viewed all nine actual final plates on cream, checker and dark contact sheets, plus larger detail views. Viewed the G01 sheet at its native 1100 by 1100 pixels, with explicitly labelled 220px whole-canvas and 220px painted-bounds examples.

observations.108-bottle: Empty translucent milky bottle, open white flip-top nozzle cap, inward dent and creases on left side. No liquid level or branding. Flexible material reads clearly.
observations.108-crate: Muted blue rigid empty crate with straight walls, reinforced rim, side openings and short-end hand-hold slots. Holes are transparent and the interior is visibly empty.
observations.108-pipe: Opaque grey rigid pipe joined to a right-angle elbow through a wider socket. Both cut ends show wall thickness. No water or printing.
observations.108-cup: Empty white tapered EPS cup with rolled rim and fine bead texture. No liquid, lid or apparatus. Beads visible in the larger dark view.
observations.108-pan: Matt dark interior, silver-grey outer wall and black handle towards upper right. Separate high rounded water beads show non-spreading water. There are many small droplets rather than only a few; this does not obscure the intended material behaviour.
observations.108-pasta: Rectangular metal catering tray with cooked penne in pale creamy sauce, clearly pale cooked chicken with lightly browned faces, parsley flecks and serving spoon. No pink raw-looking chicken, steam, table or separate backdrop.
observations.108-sandwiches: Three fanned triangular halves on a white plate, with shredded pale cooked chicken and lettuce in white bread. No packaging, utensils or table.
observations.108-vibrio: One curved comma-shaped blue-green rod with one long whip-like flagellum attached at a pole, plus shorter pili. Outer contour is smooth; painted internal shading and grain remain. No second cell or scale bar.
observations.108-tank: Galvanised corrugated cylindrical tank with roof, short upper pipe, brass tap near base, modest seam rust and raised concrete stand. No buildings, people or ground plane.

g01At220px.pasta: Tray, pasta, pale chicken pieces and spoon remain identifiable in both examples.
g01At220px.sandwiches: Three halves, white bread, pale filling, lettuce and plate remain distinct.
g01At220px.vibrio: Curved body and long polar flagellum remain identifiable. Short pili are finer in the whole-canvas 220px example, as expected.
g01At220px.tank: Tank, corrugations, stand and upper pipe remain distinct; the brass tap is small but still visible.
